Hi Mike — thanks for sending the questionnaire. We can absolutely run a technical security review next week. Suggested agenda (60m):

- 5m quick intros & scope
- 20m high-level architecture and network isolation
- 15m key management / encryption at rest & in transit
- 10m SOC2 evidence & controls mapping
- 10m Q&A + action items (including procurement asks)

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 20 Jul 09:30–10:30 PT
- Wed 21 Jul 08:30–09:30 PT
- Thu 22 Jul 10:00–11:00 PT

I’ve looped in Dylan (Solutions Eng) and Soojin (Security & Compliance) to join. Lauren (your AE) will be on the invite for commercial/context questions.

If procurement needs to join, please share a contact and we’ll include them. I also attached our Redwood security roster for your pre-read.

Best,
Marissa

One ask: can Redwood include details on key rotation cadence and whether hardware KMS/HSM options are supported for private deployments?

Sasha

Sasha Ivanov
Senior Security Engineer, Orinex Systems
sasha.ivanov@orinex.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha.ivanov@orinex.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security review request — Orinex 

Hi Sasha + team — thanks for the question. Short answers up front:
- Key rotation: supported; default rotation cadence is 90 days, configurable per-customer for Dedicated/Private deployments.
- HSM: we support BYOK with customer-managed keys via KMS integrations; for fully air-gapped/private we offer HSM-backed key wrapping options — happy to walk through details in the call.

We’ll prepare a short slide on rotation and KMS options and bring logs/evidence mapping for SOC2 controls.

Sooj
